    FAQ

    Is It Cracked? — How it works

    Quick answers about what each status means and how we track every PC game.

    01
    What does "is it cracked?" actually mean?
    It's the question of whether a PC game's copy protection (DRM) has been bypassed by a scene group so it can run without the original checks. This page answers that live for every tracked game.
    02
    Cracked
    A working scene release exists and the DRM is fully bypassed. The game runs without the original protection.
    03
    Hypervisor
    Cracked using hypervisor-based techniques — typically used against Denuvo. It's a more advanced bypass method, not a classic patch.
    04
    Uncracked
    The game is released but no working crack exists yet. The DRM (usually Denuvo) is still holding.
    05
    Unreleased
    The game hasn't launched yet. We track its release date and known DRM while it's still upcoming.
    06
    Early Access
    Publicly playable but not the final 1.0 release. Crack status for these builds is tracked separately from the full launch.
    07
    How often is the status updated?
    Statuses are updated continuously as scene releases drop and our checks run. Use the filter tabs above to jump straight to a status.
